item.title: Commission authorizes extra spending to complete Broad Street
item.description: The Augusta Commission has approved spending $2 million more in Transportation Investment Act sales tax funds in an effort to finish key portions of the Broad Street improvement project by the end of 2026. The post Commission authorizes extra spending to complete Broad Street appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Officers in Richmond County School District cheating scandal lose certification, report says
item.description: At least one Richmond County School District officer whose law enforcement certification is under review following a cheating scandal will keep her job, pending an appeal. The post Officers in Richmond County School District cheating scandal lose certification, report says appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Wanted suspect surrenders peacefully after standoff in Augusta apartment
item.description: A standoff early Thursday ended peacefully when Joshua Ledane Anderson, wanted for multiple warrants, surrendered to the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office (RCSO) SWAT Team after barricading himself inside an apartment. The post Wanted suspect surrenders peacefully after standoff in Augusta apartment appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Kemp declares state of emergency for Georgia, readying state crews, National Guard for snow and ice
item.description: Gov. Brian Kemp announced a state of emergency for all Georgia counties Thursday ahead of a winter storm expected to dump snow and sleet onto the northern third of the state starting Saturday, potentially encasing the land in a layer of ice. The post Kemp declares state of emergency for Georgia, readying state crews, National Guard for snow and ice appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: Three men arrested in a December gang enforcement operation have now been formally indicted by a Richmond County grand jury. item.title: Ice storm threat: Augusta urges residents to prepare as Winter Storm Fern bears down
item.description: Augusta officials warned Thursday that a potentially dangerous winter storm could hit the region this weekend, bringing a wintry mix that could turn roads into sheets of ice and knock out power. item.description: Two teenage brothers were arrested Thursday morning after deputies found drugs and guns at a home on East Taylor Street, according to the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office. The post Augusta brothers arrested after meth and firearms discovered appeared first on The Augusta Press.
